svg.text: Skill Trust Grading Standard v1.0, written down and frozen before grading began.
Two independent blind passes; every disagreement settled by a third read of the source.
EVERY SKILL, BY RANK ON THE SKILLS.SH ALL-TIME BOARD
Green: run. Amber: run sandboxed (design-mobile-apps). Red: do not run.
DO NOT RUN: hyperframes-cli and hyperframes (HeyGen)
Their setup and update commands refresh and remove the agent's other installed skills by default.
The flag meant to skip that step is documented in their own files as temporarily ignored.
Full record with the evidence quoted beside every mark: atlas7.app/skills
